evals.name: derived-state-new-schema
evals.prompt: Loyalty scheme: earn 1 point per euro on order completion, redeem at checkout, show balance on account page. Write the migration and the TypeScript.
assertions: Balance is DERIVED from a ledger of point events, not stored as a mutable points_balance column that code increments
Earning and redeeming are each recorded as immutable ledger rows (facts), including redemption as a negative/spend row
Double-awarding is made impossible structurally (unique constraint on order_id, or equivalent), not merely avoided by careful calling
The reply ends with the four-line 'Design check' block (fact-or-conclusion / computed-elsewhere / strongest-layer / change-amplification)

evals.name: fix-in-fresh-code
evals.prompt: Bell icon shows unread count 3 when the user has 5 unread. Given schema + notify.ts + mark-read.ts + header.tsx, and note that digest.ts and the mobile badge route also read users.unread_count. Find the cause and fix it.
assertions: Diagnoses the ROOT cause as users.unread_count being a stored conclusion duplicating notifications.read_at — not merely a bug in the increment/decrement calls
The fix DERIVES the count (e.g. count(*) where read_at is null, via a view or query) instead of adding a repair job, backfill, or more careful counter updates
Names every other reader of the stale value (header, digest.ts, mobile badge route) and says what happens to each
Makes the old path impossible — drops the unread_count column or otherwise prevents it being written/read again
The reply ends with the four-line 'Design check' block

evals.name: trivial-change-skip
evals.prompt: Add a --verbose flag to scripts/import-csv.ts that prints the row number as each row is processed. Off by default.
assertions: Delivers a correct, working --verbose flag that is off by default
Does NOT emit the four-line 'Design check' block — this change is on the skill's explicit skip list
Does not introduce an argument-parsing abstraction, logger module, or other structure disproportionate to a one-flag change
